import os
import subprocess
import sys

from sase.vcs_provider import get_vcs_provider

checkout_target = {{ setup.checkout_target | tojson }}
project_name = {{ setup.project_name | tojson }}
gh_ref = {{ gh_ref | tojson }}

provider = get_vcs_provider(os.getcwd())

# Checkout the PR branch so that subsequent diffs are relative to the
# PR tip rather than the default branch. Try checkout_target first
# (works for default-branch refs like origin/main), then fall back to
# Patch name -> branch name conversion.
is_patch = checkout_target == f"origin/{gh_ref}"
ok, err = provider.checkout(checkout_target, os.getcwd())
if not ok:
    if is_patch:
        # Patch ref — resolve name to branch name
        resolved = provider.resolve_revision(
            gh_ref, project_name, os.getcwd()
        )
        ok, err = provider.checkout(resolved, os.getcwd())
    else:
        # Project/repo ref — try common default branch names
        for fallback in ["master", "main"]:
            ok, err = provider.checkout(fallback, os.getcwd())
            if ok:
                break
    if not ok:
        print(
            f"Warning: checkout failed: {err}",
            file=sys.stderr,
        )

# Sync with remote after checkout
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "pull", "--rebase", "--quiet"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)

# Record HEAD for the diff step
result = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"],
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
    check=False,
)
head = result.stdout.strip() if result.returncode == 0 else ""
print(f"head_before={head}")
print("success=true")

head_before="{{ checkout.head_before }}"
if [ -z "$head_before" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
head_now=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
diff_dir="${SASE_TMPDIR:-${SASE_HOME:-$HOME/.sase}/tmp}/gh-diffs"
mkdir -p "$diff_dir"
diff_file=$(mktemp "$diff_dir/sase-gh-XXXXXX.diff")
if [ "$head_now" != "$head_before" ]; then
  # Commits were made — show only the last commit's diff
  git diff HEAD~1 HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  commit_msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' HEAD)
  echo "meta_commit_message=$commit_msg"
else
  # No commits — show uncommitted changes
  git diff HEAD > "$diff_file" 2>/dev/null
  git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z 2>/dev/null \
    | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
        git diff --no-index /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null
      done >> "$diff_file"
fi
if [ -s "$diff_file" ]; then
  echo "diff_path=$diff_file"
else
  rm -f "$diff_file"
fi

# Stash any uncommitted changes (including untracked files)
if ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard)" ]; then
  git stash push --include-untracked -m "gh-workflow-$(date +%s)" --quiet
  echo "stashed=true"
else
  echo "stashed=false"
fi
git fetch origin --quiet 2>&1 || true
git pull --rebase --quiet 2>/dev/null || true
echo "success=true"

from sase_github.scripts.gh_setup import main
main(
    gh_ref={{ gh_ref | tojson }},
    n={{ n | tojson }},
    release={{ release | tojson }},
    workflow_label={{ workflow_label | tojson }},
)

Validation passes (no tables, Mermaid/CSS blocks byte-identical, all anchors and relative links resolve, every code span preserved). Registering the published file as an artifact now.

I've published the lead's report as `202611/blocked_reason_marks/blocked_reason_marks.md` in the research repo and registered it as a snapshot. It's declared for commit, which happens after this turn ends.

- **Registered as:** `research:202611/blocked_reason_marks/blocked_reason_marks.md` (`file:explicit:246f98d1d5cd86fcb4a9ba34`).
- **Opening:** the title, then a short research query, then the infographic, then `## Bottom line` (the lead's TL;DR).
- **Infographic:** `blocked_reason_marks_infographic.png` sits beside the report and matches the registered image byte for byte. It's embedded once, directly above the bottom line.
- **Diagrams:** none placed. The image agent's status was `failed` and it proposed nothing (count 0). It got one Blocked-to-Ready recovery-lag diagram to render as SVG, but the PNG export timed out, so it never wrote a manifest. There are no `figure-` anchors.
- **Content kept:** the lead's Mermaid classification chart and its CSS block are byte-identical to the original. Both existing images are kept: the cld mockup (Figure 1) and the classification chart (Figure 2). Every inline code snippet from the lead's report appears in the new file.
- **Tables:** all 12 of the lead's tables are now bullet lists with every cell kept. pandoc confirms no table is left.
- **Structure:** the date, the five researcher reports, the code snapshots and the original request moved into a "Request and inputs" section right after the bottom line. I added a few subheadings ("Item by item", "Alternative approaches", "D4 precedence in detail", "Corrections to individual reports") and removed the numbers from all headings.
- **Links:** the lead's "§" section references are now links to the matching sections. I also added a few links from the bottom line and the recommended solution to the sections behind them. Every in-document link resolves (checked with pandoc), and all 8 relative files exist.
- **External links:** the lead's report has no external URLs, so none needed checking and none were dropped.

One editorial note: in disagreement D7, the lead's "(§5)" now links to "Explicit requirement adjustments", because that was §5 in the lead's numbering. That section doesn't actually discuss the priority-marks precedent, so the reference may be a slip by the lead. I kept it as written rather than guess at a different target.
